import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data from the CSV file
data = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Melt the data to create separate panels for each species
melted_data = pd.melt(data, id_vars='species', var_name='feature', value_name='value')

# Create a boxplot for each feature across the species
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.boxplot(x='species', y='value', hue='feature', data=melted_data)
plt.title('Iris Flower Measurements by Species')
plt.xlabel('Species')
plt.ylabel('Measurement (cm)')
plt.legend(title='Feature')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
